mod.name: Date Time and Counter
mod.description: Shows the current in-game day and time on the HUD.
settings.show_day_counter.name: Show day counter
settings.show_clock.name: Show in-game time
settings.show_clock.description: Display the current in-game time with the day counter.
settings.time_format.name: Time format
settings.minute_step.name: Minute steps
settings.minute_step.description: Round displayed minutes down to this interval.
settings.attach_to_location.name: Attach to location label
settings.attach_to_location.description: When disabled, show the date and time at a fixed screen position.
settings.reposition.name: Reposition widget
settings.reposition.description: Works only while Attach to location label is off. Turns off when attached. Drag with left mouse; right-click or Escape to finish.
settings.number_only.name: Show number only
settings.number_only.description: Hide the localized word for day and show only the number.
settings.attached_font_size.name: Attached font size
settings.attached_font_size.description: Text size used while the counter is attached to the location label.
settings.horizontal_position.name: Horizontal position
settings.horizontal_position.description: Distance in reference pixels from the left edge. Used only while detached.
settings.vertical_position.name: Vertical position
settings.vertical_position.description: Distance in reference pixels from the top edge. Used only while detached.
settings.detached_font_size.name: Detached font size
settings.detached_font_size.description: Text size used only while detached.
settings.show_background.name: Show background
settings.show_background.description: Show the location-style HUD frame behind the detached day counter.
